```lean
induction t with head tail using Finset.induction_on with
| [] => rw [Union_empty, ncard_empty, sum_zero]
| (h :: t) t' => 
  let s_head := s h
  let s_tail := ⋃ i ∈ t, s i
  have h1 : (s_head ∪ s_tail).ncard ≤ s_head.ncard + s_tail.ncard :=
    ncard_union_le (s_head ∪ s_tail) s_head s_tail
  rw [Union_insert, ncard_insert, sum_insert]
  exact le_trans h1 (add_le_add_right (le_refl _) (induction_h t'))
```
